externalObservation.interpretation: official-surface disagreement is currentness pressure, not target applicability truth

acceptedClaims: ResearchCorpus needs a read-only exact candidate-vs-head comparison surface for consumer-driven provider currentness.
A changed provider snapshot is evidence that provider material advanced or differed; it is not evidence that an owned target became exploitable or that Sample execution is admitted.
K1 does not justify automatic synchronization, provider mirroring, TTL freshness, or a Security-owned network fetcher.
limitations: The controlled stale/current pair is provider-shaped synthetic data used to isolate comparison semantics.
The OSV external observation is a source-surface currentness observation, not retained raw HTTP response bytes.
K1 evaluates currentness comparison, not vulnerability prioritization quality or target exploitability.
